special_doors.name: 机关门
special_doors.raw_script:
x1=8;y1=3;x2=16;y2=11;@sw=true
for y in y1...y2+1
for x in x1...x2+1
if $game_map.have_an_event?(x,y)
@iid=$game_map.check_event(x,y)
a=$game_map.events[@iid].event.name
if a[0,6]=="怪物" && a[6,3].to_i!=33
@sw=false;break
end
end
end
end
